title: An adapter test must prove which API method each command calls
rule: When an adapter (MCP tool, CLI subcommand, Tauri command, endpoint route) maps each command to one fm-api method, assert the command's result equals the API's own answer for the same request, not only its shape (is_array, non-empty, a length bound). Where two methods return lists for the same input (find_similar and suggest_pairings), also assert in the test that the two API answers differ on the test data, so a command wired to the wrong method fails.
rationale: E27.2 (#172): find_similar and get_pairings were only checked for a non-empty list, so swapping the two API calls in fm-mcp passed every test.
